title: Periapical Radiography AI Training Assistant
descriptionIntro: Welcome to the AI-Powered Periapical Radiography Training Platform. An intelligent system designed to support dental education and refine technical skills in
descriptionAnalytics: practice monitoring and statistical analytics tools
descriptionEnd: , helping evaluate skill progress and ensure diagnostic image quality.
modeClassicDesc: Identifies 12 technical errors, angulation guides & positioning corrections.
modePathologyDesc: Segments images and automatically detects supported structures and abnormalities on X-rays.
workflowStep1Desc: Select imaging technique (Paralleling / Bisecting), receptor type, and target tooth.
workflowStep2Desc: Upload clinical radiograph. Gemini automatically detects 12 technical errors.
workflowStep3Desc: Review or modify errors, access corrective guidelines, and save logs.
pathologyWorkflowStep1Desc: Select imaging technique (Paralleling / Bisecting), receptor type, and target tooth.
pathologyWorkflowStep2Desc: Upload clinical radiograph. Gemini automatically segments and detects 8 supported structures and abnormalities.
pathologyWorkflowStep3Desc: Review or modify abnormalities, view treatment recommendations, and save logs.
disclaimerDesc: PeriApicaI is currently in early-stage development. Radiographic quality assessments and pathology segmentations generated by AI are intended for educational and reference support only and may not be 100% accurate in all clinical scenarios.
disclaimerAdvice: We greatly appreciate clinicians, faculty, and residents testing the platform, verifying clinically, and providing feedback.
